assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: German school physics chapter cover, landscape 3:2.
Create a physically correct hand-cranked classroom alternating-current generator as premium editorial 3D product illustration. Geometry is essential: two large magnet pole blocks face each other across a gap from LEFT to RIGHT. Left pole terracotta, right pole slate blue. A rectangular multi-turn copper coil sits centrally in this gap. The horizontal rotation axle runs FRONT TO BACK through the center of the coil, perpendicular (90 degrees) to the left-to-right magnetic field direction. Show this geometry clearly from an elevated three-quarter front view. The coil must visibly be free to rotate in the gap about this front-back axis, without touching the poles. The axle is supported by front and rear bearings on the base, not by the side magnets. Two separate copper slip rings with graphite brushes are on the FRONT extension of the axle, and a wooden crank handle attaches at its front end. Two continuous cables lead from the stationary brushes to a small analog meter at front-left.
Materials and style: photographic material detail, brushed copper wire, matte graphite iron, pale ceramic bearing insulation, soft natural daylight, soft contact shadows, warm cream seamless background #f8f8f2, a hint of fine graph paper beneath the object, forest green and muted sage accents, magnet poles in muted terracotta #cb805b and slate blue #658e9d. Landscape 3:2 composition, centered apparatus fills two thirds of image, clean margins for cropping.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, formulas, logos, watermark, lightning, visible field lines, neon or toy plastic appearance. Meter has only unnumbered ticks and needle. Continuous connected wires. Closed copper turns, no loose or broken loops. The left-right pole axis and front-back rotation axle MUST be perpendicular. Do not place the axle across the left and right pole faces.
assets.name: generator-v3
assets.visualReview: Textfrei; Drehachse rechtwinklig zur Polachse, getrennte Schleifringe, kontinuierliche Anschlussleitungen.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: high-voltage transmission chapter cover for a German school learning website.
Edit target: the supplied generated diorama. Preserve its cream background, lighting, terrain, three pylons, substation, houses and text-free photographic model aesthetic.
Change only the electrical transmission equipment to a physically plausible arrangement: each of the three lattice pylons must have THREE crossarms, each crossarm with one long insulator string at each end. Replace the tiny pole transformer at the village edge with a compact fenced receiving substation, and route its low-voltage supply underground toward the houses. Maintain slight realistic catenary sag.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, lightning, glowing field lines, neon. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.
